vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom uses the default Undici dispatcher without custom TLS options. No Setta caller constructs Agent or EnvHttpProxyAgent with a function-valued tls.checkServerIdentity callback. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The custom certificate-pinning callback required for the bypass is absent; default certificate validation is not bypassed by this advisory.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: No workspace, fixture, test, or repository script constructs npm Undici EventSource or feeds server-sent events into its parser. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: No attacker-controlled SSE stream reaches the unbounded retained-field/chunk path.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom follows redirects in its own dispatcher. Neither Setta nor its test resource options compose Undici redirect and cache interceptors, and no shared response cache is configured. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The cross-origin redirect/cache combination required to poison a shared cache is absent.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Setta does not compose Undici decompress with a throwing downstream handler such as dump. jsdom has a separate decompression implementation, but its authored local fixtures receive no untrusted compressed network responses. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: No hostile compressed response reaches the asynchronous throwing-handler path. Reassess jsdom's copied decompression code as well as Undici before enabling remote fixtures.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: The bypass needs a Vite development server reachable over the network. Repository commands run only vite build, Vitest's in-process server, and a fixed Node file server for browser checks; none starts a development server or sets a host. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-05-vite-644-and-katex-removal).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The required network-exposed development server is absent in the checked-in commands. Reassess before adding a Vite dev server, --host, or server.host.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom exposes Undici WebSocket, but no checked-in test or workspace caller instantiates it. The CDP script instead uses Node's built-in WebSocket against its own isolated loopback Chrome endpoint. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: No untrusted WebSocket peer can flood the npm Undici automatic-PONG path; the separate Node runtime client has a trusted local peer.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom uses dispatcher.dispatch, not Undici fetch. No Setta caller imports npm Undici fetch or passes Subresource Integrity request metadata. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: Attacker-controlled response content cannot reach the mixed-case integrity-token bypass.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom's default resource loading is disabled and checked-in tests use authored local fixtures without HTTPS requests. Repository browser tooling contacts only its own loopback HTTP/CDP endpoint. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: No hostile TLS 1.2 peer can renegotiate its certificate against an Undici HTTP/1 or HTTP/2 client in these commands.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Vitest runs Node/jsdom suites with hoistMocksPlugin and automockPlugin. Neither Setta nor this Vitest Node runner registers the public mockerPlugin/interceptorPlugin WebSocket handlers that accept attacker-supplied manual mock URLs. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-10-23-supported-node-and-development-server-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The required request-to-API path is absent in the checked-in commands. Reassess before changing server configuration, middleware, mocker plugins, or network exposure.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Tailwind 3.4.1 (through postcss-nested) and @tailwindcss/typography 0.5.9 parse selectors only while building the library stylesheet from src/styles/index.css and class names in ./src. The published package does not depend on either parser, and runtime project content is never compiled as CSS. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-06-postcss-selector-parser-review).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The advisory prerequisites are absent from the published packages and checked-in build/test callers; reassess when those callers change.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Tailwind 3.4.1 (through postcss-nested) and @tailwindcss/typography 0.5.9 parse selectors only while building the library stylesheet from src/styles/index.css and class names in ./src. The published package does not depend on either parser, and runtime project content is never compiled as CSS. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-06-postcss-selector-parser-review).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The advisory prerequisites are absent from the published packages and checked-in build/test callers; reassess when those callers change.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: jsdom uses dispatcher.dispatch rather than Undici fetch, and no Setta caller imports npm Undici fetch. Tests do not load untrusted network responses. Application trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-11-04-aged-patches-and-undici-network-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The fetch-specific excessive-content-encoding rejection and orphaned response-body error path has no reachable request source.

vulnerabilityAssessments.reason: Setta does not register mockerPlugin/interceptorPlugin or their vitest:interceptor:register WebSocket handler. Node/jsdom tests therefore have no remote redirect-registration path to the Windows file-read sink. Trace and remediation: [docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md](docs/security/dependency-assessment-2026-10-09.md#addendum-2026-10-23-supported-node-and-development-server-advisories).
vulnerabilityAssessments.impact: The required request-to-API path is absent in the checked-in commands. Reassess before changing server configuration, middleware, mocker plugins, or network exposure.
